expectations.buyer: Pharmaceutical and cosmetics producer organisations, wastewater utilities, national authorities, and finance operators
expectations.pain: Micropollutant treatment costs must be allocated, invoiced, disputed, and settled across producers and utilities under evolving national implementation
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Statutory producer responsibility organisations, national registers, environmental agencies, ERP/payment rails, sector associations, and specialist compliance administrators
expectations.biggestRisk: National schemes may appoint a small number of incumbent PROs and prescribe simple fee formulas, leaving no neutral settlement rail or accessible transaction data
